I am an **Associate Professor** in the [Department of Economics](https://fss.um.edu.mo/economics/) at the **University of Macau**.

My research is in **time series and financial econometrics**, with recent work on
testing and monitoring for explosive bubbles, comparing forecasts across
frequencies, spot volatility estimation, and unit-root and cointegration testing
under nonstationary volatility.

I received my PhD in Econometrics from the **University of Amsterdam** and the
**Tinbergen Institute** in 2012. Before joining Macau I held positions at the
**University of Nottingham** and **City, University of London**.

---

### Recent

- "Improved Andrews' Formula for Testing Changing Mean" (with W. Li and X. Zhang) — forthcoming at *Economics Letters*.
- "Covariate-augmented CUSUM bubble monitoring procedures" (with S. Astill and R. Taylor) — forthcoming at *Econometric Theory*.
- "Statistical comparison of forecasts made at different frequencies" (with R. Zhang and W. Li) — forthcoming at *Journal of Business and Economic Statistics*.
- "Testing for an explosive bubble using high-frequency volatility" (with H. P. Boswijk and J. Yu) — working paper.
